name: Lucknow Nagar Nigam
headquarters: Lucknow Nagar Nigam, Trilokinath Road, Lalbagh, Lucknow-226001, Uttar Pradesh
description: Municipal corporation for the Lucknow municipal area, not all of Lucknow district. The Uttar Pradesh notification of 31 October 2022 divided the corporation area into 110 wards. Lucknow Cantonment has a separate board.
